The block sunflowers had a poor stand, even after replanting.  Decided to try to salvage some data from the plots by selecting best two plots in each rep and applying irrigated and non-irrigated treatments.  Using Walter’s canopy camera shots, selected the best two plots in each rep and confirmed these selections in the field.  Criteria was best population and adequate size for an area of about 4 rows by at least 40 ft.

Considering the treatments on these selected plots, field plumbing, and Lori/David’s weed plots, decided to fully irrigate treatments 1, 4, and 6, and not irrigate treatments 2, 3, and 5.  However, because both selected plots in Rep 3 would be unirrigated (tmnts 2 and 3), switched riser hoses between plots D34 and D43, which resulted in an 4 irrigated plots in Rep 3 and two irrigated plots in Rep 4.  This switch does not affect the weed plots (tmnts 1, 3, 4, 5) or flow rates per treatment.

Note that in each rep, the monitored plots are (by chance) side-by-side.  The relative position (E/W) of the treatments in the two monitored plots was not randomized due to the existing plumbing, although the existing plumbing (original treatments) was randomized.
